title: 🌐️ Ready Address Opening
description: 🌐️ The open-ready action uses the exact successful readiness URL of a running task. The default prefix binding is u; labels, overview rows, output context menus and custom bindings share one action. SEMIO_DASHBOARD_URL_OPENER is an optional JSON argv vector; the URL is appended as one word. Opening occurs off the view loop, has a five-second helper deadline and cancels its owned helper when the view leaves.
